name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 2px solid focus ring with a 4px outer offset, colored #005FCC on light backgrounds, to every interactive element that receives keyboard focus. This ensures keyboard users—including those with motor disabilities or screen readers—can clearly see where they are without relying on color alone. The trade-off is slightly increased visual noise for sighted users, but the ring is thin enough to minimize distraction while remaining unmistakable.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 2px ring with 4px offset fails on dark backgrounds—#005FCC blends into black, and the 4px gap may not help if the ring itself isn’t visible. Better: Use a 3px ring with 2px offset, colored #007AFF (Apple blue) for OS consistency, and test on both light/dark modes. Settle it: Run a contrast check (WCAG 2.1 AA) on both backgrounds and confirm keyboard nav works in high-contrast mode.
